name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: Hawk goes with Orin if and only if Fenwick goes with Raven.
Wrenna, Dragonborn, and Hawk belong to different adventurers.
Sable goes with either Dragonborn or Rat (but not both).
Exactly one of these is true: Elf goes with Hawk; Half-Orc goes with Viper; Human goes with Raven.

Either Hawk goes with Sable or Viper goes with Half-Orc.
Hawk goes with at least one of Orin or Dragonborn.
Raven goes with either Elf or Tiefling.
